subject: CYCLE-2 TEST RESULT: opening-attempt causal key candidate passes 9/9 adversarial oracle tests
body: Cycle 2 complete. Source finding: controllerGeneration is a reset fence, not a per-opening identity; Gen3 already has a local per-opening movementId but drops it from typed opening telemetry. Candidate key is (serviceEpoch, openingAttemptSequence), minted only on accepted NATIVE_COVER->OPENING_FROM_CLOSED and propagated end-to-end. Pure model tests: 9/9 pass, covering legacy generation-key collision, same-generation distinct openings, sparse ordered milestones, reversal stale callback rejection, privilege-loss late Binder rejection, logical display remap, unowned events, duplicate FIRST milestone rejection, and service restart isolation.
